did_you_know.title: Stono Rebellion — Largest Slave Revolt in Colonial America
did_you_know.text: Enslaved Africans in South Carolina launched the Stono Rebellion, the largest slave revolt in colonial American history, marching toward Spanish Florida in a bid for freedom.
